description: Get the Google index status of the pages tracked on a website's Indexing page in RankParse: for each page, the last stored Google URL Inspection result (verdict PASS, PARTIAL, FAIL or NEUTRAL, coverage_state such as "Crawled - currently not indexed", robots.txt state, indexing state, page fetch state, last crawl time, Google-selected canonical, any inspection error) and when it was last submitted to IndexNow, plus a summary count of indexed, not indexed and unchecked pages. Pages are re-inspected by a background job about once a day; google_inspection_available false means no verified Google property covers the website, so pages are never inspected. Not-indexed pages come first. Use get_gsc_url_inspection for a live inspection of one URL. 0 credits.

site_id.description: Logical RankParse website ID, from list_websites or list_rank_tracking_sites

status.description: Filter: not_indexed (inspected, verdict not PASS), unchecked (no verdict yet), indexed (PASS), error (last inspection failed). Default all.

name: get_indexing_status
